verdict.rationale: Granola runs several fixed background behaviors: overnight pre-meeting briefs, automatic follow-up email drafts after external meetings, and automatic enhanced-note generation when a call ends. Users can also configure a few automations themselves, such as folder-based HubSpot auto-sync and a Zapier integration for post-meeting automation. There is no evidence of a native, user-defined automation or agent builder, and Chat workflows and recipes are triggered manually with a review step before anything is sent. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers and actions that run without supervision inside Granola, general-purpose autonomous agent workflows rather than fixed built-in features, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations work reliably.
